title: Failed Visits and Inspection Rebooking on Permitted Ridgeline Installation Services Jobs
content:
On a permitted Ridgeline Installation Services job, the visits recorded on the contract set the re-inspection share of the permit handling fee.

**Clause.** Re-inspection share of the permit handling fee: when the contract records a visit at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready and no installer no-show visit, the inspection booking is redone and the re-inspection multiple of 1.25 applies; when it records an installer no-show visit and no such customer-side visit, the installer-miss share of 0.9 applies; on any other contract the re-inspection share is 1.

The permit handling fee is multiplied by the re-inspection share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the permit handling fee is rounded, the permit handling fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Records that decide the share

The visit lines of the contract, each recorded by the installer with its outcome: completed as scheduled, installer no-show, customer absent, or site not ready.

| Customer-absent or site-not-ready visits | Installer no-show visits | Re-inspection share |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | none | 1.25 |
| none | one or more | 0.9 |
| one or more | one or more | 1 |
| none | none | 1 |

**Hypothetical:** a handling fee of 95.00 before the share becomes 118.75 when only the customer side caused failed visits, and 85.50 when only the installer missed a visit.
